# Frequently Asked Questions


This page is intended as a "quick-fix" repositroty for common issues and simple solutions for the **Medical Statistics** course.

---

## Issues with R

### R will not run my code

Check the following:
    -   Load the packages you want to use
    -   Check that the data is loaded and is an object in the variables pane
    -   Otherwise, restart R and try again
---

## Using other software

### Can I use other software than R?

In this course, no. You are very welcome to use any other software before or after the course. However, for this specific course, we evaluate your skills in R.

### Can I use other software than RStudio?

You are welcome to use any IDE you want. However, we will not give special instructions on using other IDEs, so this is your own responsibility.
